payload.title: Read the audit export limit from config
payload.goal: Move the hard-coded audit export limit in src/lib/audit.ts into configuration: add auditExportLimit to loadConfig() in src/config.ts, read from the environment with the current value as the default, and pass it to AuditLog when createDeps builds it in src/app.ts. Add tests in test/config.test.ts and test/audit.test.ts.
acceptance: The export limit comes from config with today's value as the default
A small configured limit makes the CSV export keep only that many rows
No limit constant is left in a route or in the audit library
The suite stays green with new tests for the config value and the cap

payload.text:
The implementation from the previous run was already complete and correct; I verified it and it stays as-is. Suite is green (29 passed) and typecheck is clean.

decision: tests: test/config.test.ts changed because the Config shape gained auditExportLimit, so the toEqual assertions must include the new field, plus a new case covering its default/env/fallback.
decision: tests: test/audit.test.ts changed because the task acceptance requires a test proving a small configured limit caps the CSV export to the newest rows.

What was done (verified, no new edits needed):
- `src/config.ts`: `auditExportLimit` added to `Config`, read from `AUDIT_EXPORT_LIMIT` with default 5000 via `positiveInt`.
- `src/lib/audit.ts`: `EXPORT_LIMIT` constant removed; `AuditLog` takes `exportLimit` in its constructor and `toCsv` uses `slice(-this.exportLimit)`.
- `src/app.ts`: `createDeps` builds `new AuditLog(config.auditExportLimit)`.
- No limit constant remains in any route or in the audit library (grep confirms only the config default and its uses).
- New tests: config default/env/fallback case for the audit limit, and an audit test capping CSV output at a configured limit of 2 while keeping the newest rows.

What I did not finish: nothing open - all four acceptance points hold.
What I did not look at: the `review-voice-policy` skill (not applicable, no policy file touched) and the remaining route/lib files beyond `src/routes/audit.ts` (confirmed no limit constant there via grep).
